---- MODULE W4Od9m2p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, Targets

VARIABLES rec, replica, phase, prop, prepared

vars == <<rec, replica, phase, prop, prepared>>

NONE == 0

TypeOK ==
    /\ rec \in Targets
    /\ replica \in [Controllers -> Targets]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "prepare", "commit"}
    /\ prop \in Targets
    /\ prepared \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ replica = [c \in Controllers |-> 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = 0
    /\ prepared = {}

Propose(v) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ v # rec
    /\ phase' = "prepare"
    /\ prop' = v
    /\ prepared' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, replica>>

Prepare(c) ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ c \notin prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, replica, phase, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "prepare"
    /\ prepared = Controllers
    /\ rec' = prop
    /\ phase' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<replica, prop, prepared>>

Apply(c) ==
    /\ phase = "commit"
    /\ replica[c] # rec
    /\ replica' = [replica EXCEPT ![c] = rec]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, phase, prop, prepared>>

Finish ==
    /\ phase = "commit"
    /\ \A c \in Controllers : replica[c] = rec
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = 0
    /\ prepared' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, replica>>

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Targets : Propose(v)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Prepare(c) \/ Apply(c)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Finish

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ReplicasReflectRecordWhenIdle ==
    phase = "idle" => \A c \in Controllers : replica[c] = rec
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder coordinates a shared load-shedding record across several substation controllers using two-phase commit. Each controller keeps a local replica of the authoritative shed value, and the coordinator drives updates so that no committed change is ever lost by a replica. A new shed target is proposed only when the coordinator is idle, moving it into the prepare phase. Each controller then prepares by acknowledging the proposal; some controllers are slow and acknowledge later than others, but none ever fail outright. Once every controller has prepared, the coordinator commits, writing the new value into the authoritative record. Controllers then apply the committed value into their local replicas one at a time, and only after every replica matches the record does the coordinator return to idle. Because the coordinator refuses to become idle while any replica still lags, the shared record and all replicas stay in agreement whenever a round is complete.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the coordinator is idle, every controller's local replica equals the authoritative shed value, so no committed update has been lost.

---- MODULE W4Od7m9p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, MaxEpoch
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, freePool, epoch, craneEpoch, crashed
vars == <<owner, freePool, epoch, craneEpoch, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Cranes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ freePool \subseteq Slots
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ craneEpoch \in [Cranes -> 1..MaxEpoch]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ freePool = Slots
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ craneEpoch = [c \in Cranes |-> 1]
    /\ crashed = {}

Allocate(c, s) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ craneEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ s \in freePool
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ freePool' = freePool \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, craneEpoch, crashed>>

Release(c, s) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ owner[s] = c
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ freePool' = freePool \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, craneEpoch, crashed>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, freePool, epoch, craneEpoch>>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ owner' = [s \in Slots |-> IF owner[s] \in crashed THEN NONE ELSE owner[s]]
    /\ freePool' = freePool \cup {s \in Slots : owner[s] \in crashed}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<craneEpoch, crashed>>

Resync(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ craneEpoch[c] # epoch
    /\ craneEpoch' = [craneEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, freePool, epoch, crashed>>

Recover(c) ==
    /\ c \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, freePool, epoch, craneEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Allocate(c, s) \/ Release(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Crash(c) \/ Resync(c) \/ Recover(c)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FreePoolPartition ==
    \A s \in Slots : (s \in freePool) <=> (owner[s] = NONE)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {k1, k2}
    Slots = {s1, s2, s3}
    MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FreePoolPartition
nl:
A container-ship crane yard assigns yard bays (slots) to gantry cranes and periodically reconfigures the whole yard by bumping a global epoch number. Every crane operates at some epoch and may only allocate a bay while it is synchronized to the current epoch. A free bay may be allocated by an in-epoch crane, and a crane may release a bay it holds back to the free pool. Any crane can crash silently at any time; a crashed crane stops acting but its bays remain until reclaimed. When the yard reconfigures, the epoch advances, and every bay still held by a crashed crane is reclaimed into the free pool so it can be reissued. A crashed crane may also recover, rejoining the yard but needing to resynchronize to the current epoch before allocating. Non-crashed cranes must resynchronize to the new epoch before they can allocate again. The system maintains a strict partition between the free pool and the set of allocated bays so that no bay is ever handed out twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A bay is in the free pool exactly when it has no owner, so no allocated bay is ever also considered free and available for a second allocation.

---- MODULE W4Od17m6p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, Lease, MaxClock, MaxVer
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES record, holder, expiry, clock, base, crashed
vars == <<record, holder, expiry, clock, base, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ holder \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxClock + Lease)
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ base \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ crashed \subseteq Nodes

Init ==
    /\ record = 0
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ base = 0
    /\ crashed = {}

Acquire(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ \/ holder = NONE
       \/ expiry <= clock
    /\ holder' = n
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ base' = record
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, clock, crashed>>

Write(n) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ base = record
    /\ record < MaxVer
    /\ record' = record + 1
    /\ base' = record + 1
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, crashed>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, holder, expiry, base, crashed>>

Reclaim ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ expiry <= clock
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ base' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, expiry, clock, crashed>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, holder, expiry, clock, base>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, holder, expiry, clock, base>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Acquire(n) \/ Write(n) \/ Crash(n) \/ Recover(n)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Reclaim

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

LiveHolderSnapshotCurrent ==
    (holder # NONE /\ clock < expiry) => base = record
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    Lease = 2
    MaxClock = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LiveHolderSnapshotCurrent
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates writes to a single shared routing record using lease-based ownership with expiry. A router node acquires an exclusive lease on the record for a bounded duration, snapshotting the record's current version at acquisition time. Only the node holding a live lease may update the record, and each update advances the record's version and renews the lease. A global clock ticks forward, and when a lease's expiry time is reached the lease is released so another node may acquire it. Any node may crash silently; a crashed node simply stops acting, its lease is reclaimed once it expires, and it may later recover and rejoin. Because writes are serialized through the exclusive lease, the active lease holder's snapshotted base version always matches the record's current version. If a stale snapshot ever wrote, an intervening update would be silently lost, so keeping the snapshot current is exactly what prevents lost updates.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a node holds a live, unexpired lease, its snapshotted base version equals the record's current version, so no committed update to the shared record can be lost.

---- MODULE W4Od17m5p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Routers, Slots, Voters, Quorum
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, claimant, votes
vars == <<owner, claimant, votes>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Routers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claimant \in [Slots -> Routers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ votes \in [Slots -> SUBSET Voters]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ claimant = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]

Claim(r, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ claimant[s] = NONE
    /\ claimant' = [claimant EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Vote(v, s) ==
    /\ claimant[s] # NONE
    /\ v \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = votes[s] \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claimant>>

Grant(s) ==
    /\ claimant[s] # NONE
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ Cardinality(votes[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = claimant[s]]
    /\ claimant' = [claimant EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimant, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers, s \in Slots : Claim(r, s)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, s \in Slots : Vote(v, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Grant(s) \/ Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OwnedSlotHasNoPendingClaim ==
    \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # NONE => claimant[s] = NONE
====
nl:
An airport baggage router allocates conveyor destination slots to routers, and every allocation must be approved by a quorum of voting supervisors. To claim a free slot, a router registers itself as the slot's claimant, after which supervisors cast approval votes for that specific claim. Supervisors are slow but never fail: they may cast their votes in any order and at any pace, but each eventually votes. Once a claim has collected a quorum of votes and the slot is still unowned, the claim is granted and the router becomes the slot's owner, clearing the pending claim. An owner may later release its slot, returning it to the unallocated state so it can be claimed again. Because a grant clears the claim and a claim can only be registered on an unowned slot, an allocated slot never carries a competing pending claim at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a slot has an owner, it has no pending claimant, so the same slot is never simultaneously owned and in the process of being allocated again.

---- MODULE W4Od9m2p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Coordinators, Participants, Capacity, Amounts

VARIABLES used, phase, amount, reserved, votes
vars == <<used, phase, amount, reserved, votes>>

ReservedTotal == reserved[CHOOSE i \in Coordinators : TRUE]
                 + reserved[CHOOSE i \in Coordinators : i # (CHOOSE j \in Coordinators : TRUE)]

TypeOK ==
    /\ used \in 0..Capacity
    /\ phase \in [Coordinators -> {"idle", "preparing", "committed"}]
    /\ amount \in [Coordinators -> Amounts]
    /\ reserved \in [Coordinators -> 0..Capacity]
    /\ votes \in [Coordinators -> SUBSET Participants]

Init ==
    /\ used = 0
    /\ phase = [i \in Coordinators |-> "idle"]
    /\ amount = [i \in Coordinators |-> 0]
    /\ reserved = [i \in Coordinators |-> 0]
    /\ votes = [i \in Coordinators |-> {}]

Begin(i, a) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ used + ReservedTotal + a <= Capacity
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "preparing"]
    /\ amount' = [amount EXCEPT ![i] = a]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![i] = a]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED used

Vote(i, p) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "preparing"
    /\ p \notin votes[i]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![i] = votes[i] \cup {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<used, phase, amount, reserved>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "preparing"
    /\ votes[i] = Participants
    /\ used' = used + amount[i]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<amount, votes>>

Abort(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "preparing"
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<used, amount, votes>>

Complete(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "committed"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<used, amount, reserved, votes>>

Reduce ==
    /\ used > 0
    /\ used' = used - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, amount, reserved, votes>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Coordinators, a \in Amounts : Begin(i, a)
    \/ \E i \in Coordinators, p \in Participants : Vote(i, p)
    \/ \E i \in Coordinators : Commit(i) \/ Abort(i) \/ Complete(i)
    \/ Reduce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PoolNeverOvercommitted ==
    used + ReservedTotal <= Capacity
====
nl:
A power-grid load shedder runs two independent shedding coordinators that draw from one shared reserve pool of megawatts. Each coordinator commits shedding rounds using two-phase commit over its substation participants. When a coordinator begins a round it first reserves the requested megawatts against the shared pool, but only if the already-committed load plus all outstanding reservations plus the new request still fit within total capacity. Participants then cast prepare votes, and once every participant has prepared the round commits, converting the reservation into committed load. A coordinator may instead abort an in-flight round, releasing its reservation back to the pool. Completed shedding gradually finishes and frees committed load back into the pool. Because reservations are charged up front against the same shared capacity, the two coordinators can never jointly overcommit the pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total committed load plus all outstanding reservations across both coordinators never exceeds the shared pool capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od4m0p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cars, Slots, MaxVer
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES owner, slotVer, phase, attempt, snap
vars == <<owner, slotVer, phase, attempt, snap>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Cars \cup {NONE}]
    /\ slotVer \in [Slots -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ phase \in [Cars -> {"idle", "verifying"}]
    /\ attempt \in [Cars -> Slots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ snap \in [Cars -> 0..MaxVer]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ slotVer = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [c \in Cars |-> "idle"]
    /\ attempt = [c \in Cars |-> NONE]
    /\ snap = [c \in Cars |-> 0]

Read(c, s) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ owner[s] = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "verifying"]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = s]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = slotVer[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, slotVer>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "verifying"
    /\ LET s == attempt[c] IN
        /\ owner[s] = NONE
        /\ slotVer[s] = snap[c]
        /\ slotVer[s] < MaxVer
        /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = c]
        /\ slotVer' = [slotVer EXCEPT ![s] = slotVer[s] + 1]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Retry(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "verifying"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, slotVer, snap>>

Release(c, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = c
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotVer, phase, attempt, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars, s \in Slots : Read(c, s) \/ Release(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Commit(c) \/ Retry(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

StaleAttemptCannotDoubleBook ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        owner[s] # NONE =>
            \A c \in Cars : (phase[c] = "verifying" /\ attempt[c] = s) => snap[c] < slotVer[s]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {c1, c2, c3}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT StaleAttemptCannotDoubleBook
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line assigns wash bays (slots) to cars using optimistic locking with retry. To claim a bay, a car first reads a free bay, snapshotting that bay's version number, and enters a verifying state; cars are slow and may take arbitrarily long between reading and committing. On commit, the car re-checks that the bay is still free and its version still matches the snapshot; if so it takes ownership and bumps the bay's version. If the version has moved or the bay was taken, the car simply retries from scratch. An owner may later release its bay, freeing it for future cars. Because a bay's version strictly increases each time it is claimed, and cars only read bays that are currently free, any car still attempting a bay that has since been claimed necessarily holds a stale snapshot and will be forced to retry rather than double-book it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Once a bay is owned, every car still attempting that bay holds a version snapshot strictly older than the bay's current version, so no bay is ever allocated to two cars.

---- MODULE W4Od1m8p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Planes, Segments, TotalCredits
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES pool, held, coarse, fine, requests
vars == <<pool, held, coarse, fine, requests>>

RECURSIVE SumHeld(_)
SumHeld(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN held[x] + SumHeld(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..TotalCredits
    /\ held \in [Planes -> 0..TotalCredits]
    /\ coarse \in Planes \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Segments -> Planes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ requests \subseteq Planes

Init ==
    /\ pool = TotalCredits
    /\ held = [p \in Planes |-> 0]
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [g \in Segments |-> NONE]
    /\ requests = {}

Submit(p) ==
    /\ p \notin requests
    /\ requests' = requests \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, coarse, fine>>

Cancel(p) ==
    /\ p \in requests
    /\ coarse # p
    /\ requests' = requests \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, coarse, fine>>

AcquireCoarse(p) ==
    /\ p \in requests
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, fine, requests>>

Land(p, g) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ fine[g] = NONE
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![g] = p]
    /\ pool' = pool - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = held[p] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, requests>>

Depart(p, g) ==
    /\ fine[g] = p
    /\ held[p] > 0
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![g] = NONE]
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = held[p] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, requests>>

ReleaseCoarse(p) ==
    /\ coarse = p
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ requests' = requests \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, held, fine>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Submit(p) \/ Cancel(p) \/ AcquireCoarse(p) \/ ReleaseCoarse(p)
    \/ \E p \in Planes, g \in Segments : Land(p, g) \/ Depart(p, g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CreditsConserved ==
    pool + SumHeld(Planes) = TotalCredits
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Planes = {a1, a2}
    Segments = {g1, g2}
    TotalCredits = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CreditsConserved
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator hands out a fixed number of landing credits to aircraft using hierarchical locks: an aircraft must first hold the coarse whole-runway lock, then a fine per-segment lock, before it may draw a credit from the central pool to land on a segment. Landing requests arrive as a pool of pending messages that controllers may service in any order, modelling network reordering. An aircraft submits a request, acquires the coarse lock while its request is pending, then lands on a free segment, which moves exactly one credit from the central pool into that aircraft's possession. When an aircraft departs a segment it returns its credit to the central pool and frees the segment. The coarse lock can be released independently so other aircraft may proceed. Since every landing moves one credit out of the pool and every departure moves one back, the total number of credits in the system is conserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The credits remaining in the central pool plus the credits held by all aircraft always equals the fixed total number of credits.

---- MODULE W4Od4m0p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Workers, Total, MaxVer

VARIABLES tankA, tankB, ver, phase, snapVer, dir
vars == <<tankA, tankB, ver, phase, snapVer, dir>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ tankA \in 0..Total
    /\ tankB \in 0..Total
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ phase \in [Workers -> {"idle", "ready"}]
    /\ snapVer \in [Workers -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ dir \in [Workers -> {"none", "AtoB", "BtoA"}]

Init ==
    /\ tankA = Total
    /\ tankB = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ phase = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ snapVer = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ dir = [w \in Workers |-> "none"]

Read(w, d) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "idle"
    /\ d \in {"AtoB", "BtoA"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "ready"]
    /\ snapVer' = [snapVer EXCEPT ![w] = ver]
    /\ dir' = [dir EXCEPT ![w] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tankA, tankB, ver>>

CommitAtoB(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "ready"
    /\ dir[w] = "AtoB"
    /\ ver = snapVer[w]
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ tankA > 0
    /\ tankA' = tankA - 1
    /\ tankB' = tankB + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ dir' = [dir EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snapVer

CommitBtoA(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "ready"
    /\ dir[w] = "BtoA"
    /\ ver = snapVer[w]
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ tankB > 0
    /\ tankB' = tankB - 1
    /\ tankA' = tankA + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ dir' = [dir EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED snapVer

Retry(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "ready"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ dir' = [dir EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tankA, tankB, ver, snapVer>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, d \in {"AtoB", "BtoA"} : Read(w, d)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : CommitAtoB(w) \/ CommitBtoA(w) \/ Retry(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FluidConserved ==
    tankA + tankB = Total
====

CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2}
    Total = 3
    MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FluidConserved
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves cleaning fluid between two tanks using optimistic locking with retry over a shared, versioned pair of tank levels. Each worker reads the current version number and the tank levels, decides to move one unit either from tank A to tank B or from B to A, and enters a ready state. Workers commit in any order, so their commit messages effectively arrive reordered relative to their reads. On commit, a worker succeeds only if the shared version still matches the version it snapshotted; it then applies its one-unit transfer and bumps the version. If the version has advanced because another worker committed first, the worker abandons the attempt and retries. Since every accepted transfer merely moves one unit from one tank to the other, the combined fluid across both tanks is never created or destroyed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of the two tank levels always equals the fixed total amount of cleaning fluid.

---- MODULE W4Od19m8p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

TypeOK ==
    /\ catalog \in Patrons \cup {NONE}
    /\ bookLock \in [Books -> Patrons \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pstate \in [Patrons -> {"idle", "holding", "reading"}]
    /\ target \in [Patrons -> Books \cup {NONE}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Patrons

    /\ bookLock = [b \in Books |-> NONE]
    /\ pstate = [p \in Patrons |-> "idle"]
    /\ target = [p \in Patrons |-> NONE]
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireCatalog(p, b) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ pstate[p] = "idle"
    /\ catalog = NONE
    /\ catalog' = p
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "holding"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![p] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, crashed>>

AcquireBook(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ pstate[p] = "holding"
    /\ bookLock[target[p]] = NONE
    /\ bookLock' = [bookLock EXCEPT ![target[p]] = p]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "reading"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<catalog, target, crashed>>

LeaveReading(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "reading"
    /\ bookLock' = [bookLock EXCEPT ![target[p]] = NONE]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<catalog, target, crashed>>

ReleaseCatalog(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "holding"
    /\ catalog = p
    /\ catalog' = NONE
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bookLock, crashed>>

Crash(p) ==
    /\ p \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
    /\ catalog' = IF catalog = p THEN NONE ELSE catalog
    /\ bookLock' = [b \in Books |-> IF bookLock[b] = p THEN NONE ELSE bookLock[b]]
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]

Recover(p) ==
    /\ p \in crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<catalog, bookLock, pstate, target>>

    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : AcquireCatalog(p, b)

A library book reservation system lets patrons read rare books under hierarchical locks: a patron must first acquire the coarse catalog lock, then the fine per-book lock, before entering the reading room with that book. Only one patron may hold the catalog lock at a time, and only then may that patron acquire a specific book's lock and begin reading it. A reading patron eventually leaves the reading room, releasing the book lock but keeping the catalog lock, and later releases the catalog lock to return to idle. Any patron may crash silently at any moment; when a patron crashes, whatever catalog and book locks it held are reclaimed and it returns to idle so others can proceed. A crashed patron may later recover and rejoin. Because entering the reading room requires holding the specific book's fine lock, and each book's lock is held by at most one patron, the reading of any given book is mutually exclusive.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A patron is in the reading room with a book only while holding that book's fine lock, so no two patrons ever read the same book simultaneously.

A university course-registration system admits enrollment requests into a bounded work queue that applies backpressure when full, and its capacity can change at runtime as the registrar adds or removes worker slots. A student's enrollment is admitted into the pending queue only when the student is not already pending or enrolled and the queue has room below its current capacity; otherwise backpressure blocks admission rather than dropping the request. A worker later processes a pending enrollment, moving that student from pending into the committed enrolled record. A print shop job spooler cycles a fixed set of reusable print trays through a bounded FIFO spool queue with backpressure, and the spool's capacity can change at runtime. The shop manager may grow or shrink the spool capacity between runs, but shrinking never discards trays already in the queue. Since trays are only ever moved between the available rack, the spool queue, and the in-press set, and never created or destroyed, the total number of trays in the shop is conserved.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of trays in the available rack plus the number queued in the spool plus the number in the press always equals the fixed total number of trays.

A client synchronizes by advancing its known epoch to the current one, and may then register a course seat only while its epoch matches the current epoch and it is not already registered. Registered clients may deregister at any time. A privileged administrator may override the epoch check to directly register a client and pin that registration, and may later unpin it, which also cancels that override registration. SAFETY PROPERTY: Every registered client either has its epoch equal to the current epoch or is an administrator-pinned registration, so no stale-epoch client registration remains in force.

When the bank reconfigures into a new epoch, any reservation held by a crashed technician is cleared so the unit is not stranded. Because a unit can be reserved only while it is still stored, and transfusing clears the reservation, a unit that has already been transfused never carries a reservation and so can never be transfused a second time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every transfused unit has no outstanding reservation, so the irreversible transfusion of any unit happens at most once.
